description: Voting permissions: preparation and closing statuses, chair and manager, draft management, viewer actions.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress; viewer is the Chair.
cases.return: CanManageDraft true, CanOpen true, CanClose true, CanRecordConclusion true.

preconditions: Meeting Ended; viewer is the Chair.
cases.return: CanManageDraft false, CanOpen false, CanClose true, CanRecordConclusion true.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress; viewer is the Secretary.
cases.return: CanManageDraft true; CanOpen, CanClose and CanRecordConclusion false.

preconditions: Meeting Published; viewer is the Chair.
cases.return: CanManageDraft true; CanOpen false (not started); CanClose false; CanRecordConclusion false.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress; viewer is a Member.
